desc:
🌊 Welcome to +1 DON'T SPLASH, IT KNOWS 👁️

How to Play:
🏚️ Explore the mysterious Backrooms
💧 Don't touch the water... IT can hear you!
🏃 Jump across obstacles without falling
👁️ Avoid the monster lurking beneath
🚪 Find your way out and escape the Backrooms
🏆 Survive and reach the end!

👍 If you're having fun, don't forget to like the game!

+1 DONT SPLASH is inspired by the eerie atmosphere of the Poolrooms and House of the Locust.
